title: S07T04 - Implement extension install, inspect, update, remove, doctor, and recovery
description: Provide previewable lifecycle commands with lock safety, backups, atomic writes, signature checks, conflict handling, and rollback.
acceptanceCriteria: All lifecycle mutations support dry-run, record operation evidence, and roll back cleanly after partial failure.
Removing an extension refuses when durable records still require its schemas or policies unless a reviewed migration is supplied.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
